visual_observations.observation: A young woman is sitting at a table in what appears to be a restaurant, holding chopsticks and eating from a bowl. There is a small pot next to her bowl. Restaurant decor is visible in the background.

visible_text.text: Most people don't see this side of acid reflux. It's not just physical pain. Out of nowhere, you get anxiety attacks. Your heart races, your chest feels weird, and you start panicking then you become afraid of having another attack, and that fear itself creates even more anxiety. It's not "in your head." It's not a myth. It's real. And for anyone fighting acid reflux, it can honestly feel like a nightmare.

hook_evidence.evidence: The video immediately displays text: 'Most people don't see this side of acid reflux. It's not just physical pain.' This statement aims to capture the attention of individuals who experience acid reflux by highlighting a less commonly discussed aspect of the condition.
